_comment: Les 2 Alpes corrections. IDS ARE FROM THE CURRENT `npm run data` BUILD; `data:refresh` renumbers nodes. (1) OSM tags a disused run 'ancienne piste intermédiaire "Bons"' (ancienne = former) NW near Mont-de-Lans; it is not an operational piste and imports as a disconnected island, so remove it. (2) The Venosc village gondola ('Venosc', 991 m -> 1632 m) tops out ~410 m from the resort base with no piste/path tagged from its top station, leaving it a 2-node island. Add a pedestrian-transfer connector from its top (n384) to the Super Venosc gondola base (n266, 1692 m) so skiers arriving from Venosc can continue up.
